policies.text: An enterprise designation is granted when network hardware exhibits data throughput of at least 10 Gbps or maintains an ISO 27001 certification.
An electronic component is approved for export when its lead content remains under 0.1 percent.
A hardware device is listed on public purchasing registers provided the system has earned enterprise designation.
A lighting fixture achieves domestic electrical compliance whenever the product carries a UL safety certification.
A commercial appliance receives premium tier rating if its operational noise level stays below 40 dB.
